subject: Gate results for arms J (temperature 1.2) and K (top_k 100). Gates predeclared 2026-08-24T03:2xZ before either was pushed; read under the same day's amendment.

arm_J_temperature_12.reading: 31 levels against the incumbent's 35 and a pooled control of 32.3, with zero-level games UP from 4 to 7 and the paired sign test leaning the wrong way (3 gained / 6 lost). It is inside the noise band and it does not clear any bar. Under the amendment a tie goes to the incumbent, so it does not ship. Combined with arm G (temperature 0.3, 22 levels), the temperature dose-response is now 0.3 -> 22, 0.6 -> 33 and 29, 0.9 -> 35, 1.2 -> 31. **Temperature 0.9 is the shipping value and the axis is closed.**

arm_K_top_k_100.change: LOCAL_ANALYZER_TOP_K 20 -> 100 at temperature 0.9. Single variable, verified: identical src tree hash to the incumbent, exactly one differing line in setup_commands.json.
why_this_one_is_different_from_every_pre: SIZE. 44 levels against a pooled control of 32.3 is +11.7, which is z = 1.9 to 2.3 against the measured arm-minus-control sigma of 5.1 to 6.1. Every previous arm this project ran asked a 1-to-4 level question that the instrument could not resolve. This one is near the instrument's own 80%-power MDE of about 12.6 levels.

BREADTH, which is the thing we actually needed. Zero-level games fell to 1, against 4, 5 and 7 in the three control runs. The 2026-08-24 gap analysis said our board profile is 'a level-1 machine' with roughly 22 of 55 hidden games scoring zero, and that converting zeros is the cheapest path to rank 5.

IT SOLVED A GAME NOTHING HAD EVER SOLVED. tr87-cd924810 was one of exactly two hard zeros across all 14 prior q38 arms; arm K cleared 2 levels on it. That is a qualitatively new event, not a shift in a total.
FOUR INDEPENDENT STATISTICS ALL MOVED THE SAME WAY: total levels 35 -> 44, zero-level games 4 -> 1, shipped-scorer mean 6.722 -> 8.246 (+23%), paired sign test 9 gained / 3 lost.

THE MECHANISM IS COHERENT AND WAS PREDICTED IN ADVANCE. The predeclared gate argued that top_k = 20 hard-caps what temperature can do, because at 20 candidates a raised temperature only reshapes probability inside the same 20 tokens. Removing that clamp is what let the raised temperature produce exploration, and exploration is what converts zero-level games.
honest_weaknesses: n = 1. The paired sign test against the incumbent is p = 0.073 one-sided, not below 0.05. It reaches p = 0.019 only against the weakest of the three control runs, which is the wrong comparison to lead with.
A byte-identical replicate of a DIFFERENT config moved 33 -> 29 on the same instrument the same week, so +11.7 is roughly two noise units, not ten.
top_k = 100 deviates from Qwen's own recommended sampling for this model (temperature 1.0, top_p 0.95, top_k 20). We are off-vendor on purpose, and the only evidence is this one run.
A confirmation run (arm P, byte-identical) is already pushed and lands in about 2h15m, before today's submission slot at 17:06 Pacific.
arm_K_top_k_100.rollback: vineethsaivs/arc3-q38-ctxwin-temp09-ordinary-commit v1 (temperature 0.9, top_k 20), or vineethsaivs/arc3-q38-ctxwin-ordinary-commit v1, the temperature-0.6 config that drew 1.87 and 2.39.

temperature_dose_response_CLOSED.conclusion: 0.9 is the shipping value. Do not spend another commit on temperature.
